notes.title: Update 1.2.09030
notes.notes:
Fixed the final achievement requiring a restart to fire

Upgraded to Unity 6

notes.title: Update 1.1.02081
notes.notes:
Fixed a bug in which double-clicking on a tile could cause a mismatch between a tile’s visual state and its "true" state.
 Using Ctrl+Z to undo no longer triggers the zoom-in keyboard shortcut at the same time.
 Fixed the undo feature panning the camera to random locations instead of undoing your moves.

notes.title: Update 1.1.01102
notes.notes:
Fixed the missing % symbol on the main menu in some languages
 Z and X now function as keyboard shortcuts for zooming in and out
 Added button to the settings menu linking to the Discord.
 Added button to the settings menu linking to the Mailing List, where you can subscribe to hear about new games in the series.

notes.title: Update 1.1.01040
notes.notes:
This update addresses a couple of issues raised by the community:


 Tile and error colours have been adjusted to improve contrast.
 The error sound effect no longer plays when error detection is turned off.

I also just wanted to wish you all a Happy New Year, and say a huge thank you to everyone that has so generously donated to the UNICEF fundraiser so far!
